contexts.text: They say... He is worse than a heathen...
Gods and goddesses for whom the heathen afterwards instituted Divine worship.
It is a general opinion that those who have been born outside the Church, who are called heathen and Gentiles, cannot be saved...
Every Christian, and also heathen, who has religion and sound reason...
The works of charity done by a Christian, and those done by a heathen, in the external form appear alike...
I have spoken with nations who have been heathens; and who, then, have been wise...
On those who are in faith alone, that they have become heathens of no religion.
